# Modelado

> Free Windows app that turns a photo into a 3D model (a whole object with TripoSR, or a relief
> with Depth Anything V2) with AI running on the user's own PC. No NVIDIA GPU is needed: it runs on
> AMD and Intel graphics through DirectML, and on a CPU-only PC, more slowly. No photo is uploaded,
> no account is needed.

## Hardware

- No NVIDIA card and no CUDA are needed. The models run in ONNX Runtime with DirectML, on any
  DirectX 12 graphics card: AMD, Intel or NVIDIA.
- CPU only: yes. Without a usable GPU everything runs on the CPU. Measured with modelado-cli on a
  512 px photo, 8 cores of an Intel Core i7-14700: a 3D Object in about 20 s, a relief in about
  1 s. On 4 cores with the FP32 models, a 3D Object took 38 s.
- On an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 through DirectML: a 3D Object in about 4 s.
- If a model fails on the GPU (out of video memory, for example), it runs again on the CPU and the
  window says so.
- Windows 10 (1903 or later) or Windows 11, x64.

## What it does

- 3D Object: one photo of an object becomes a closed, coloured mesh, its unseen sides inferred.
- Relief: any photo becomes a bas-relief textured with the photo, with a solid base for printing.
- Edit and improve: simplify, subdivide, smooth, fill holes, flatten a base, 4x sharper texture
  (Real-ESRGAN), on generated models and on opened GLB, OBJ, PLY or STL files.
- Export to GLB, OBJ, PLY or STL, sized in millimetres.
- The AI models are downloaded once, on first use, after the app says how large they are and where
  they come from. Meshy AI and Ideogram are optional, with the user's own key.
